newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Menang Corp proposes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Menang Corp proposes private placement.

text.p: Menang Corp Bhd said on Friday that it is proposing a private placement of 20 million new ordinary shares representing 9.82 percent of its issued and paid-up capital.

The company said in a statement that the issue price of the new shares would be based on the lower of the weighted average market price for the past five days, or the closing market price prior to the announcement of the price fixing date, with a discount of not more than 10 percent.
The price fixing date will be announced after the company receives approval for the placement from the Securities Commission.
The property development and project management concern said that proceeds from the placement would be used to repay debt and for additional working capital.
After the placement, Menang's share capital will rise from 203.69 million shares to 223.69 million shares.
